name: FormPath
title: vector illustration on your own machine
summary: FormPath is an open-source (Apache-2.0) vector illustration app with artboards, Pen and Curvature tools, Pathfinder, live effects, type, SVG, PDF, EPS and DXF.
lede: FormPath is the vector member of the Form family, with artboards, layers, live shapes, the Pen and Curvature tools, Pathfinder, gradients, an appearance stack with live effects and variable fonts. It saves its own .fpth projects and reads and writes SVG, PDF, EPS and DXF. It runs in a browser or as a desktop app.
runs_on: macOS, Windows and Linux (desktop build targets: all); also in a browser
checks: Draws with Pen, Curvature, Pencil, Paintbrush and live shapes that stay editable after drawing.
Combines paths with all ten Pathfinder operations, Fill Regions, Offset Path, Outline Stroke and Simplify.
Opens any PDF or PDF-compatible .ai as editable art, one artboard per page, and writes SVG, PDF, PNG, JPEG and WebP.
Lets agents draw through an MCP server with 93 tools, with Claude Code running inside its own terminal dock.

facts.dd: .fpth, SVG, PDF, PDF-compatible .ai, EPS and DXF
SVG, PDF, EPS, DXF, PNG, JPEG and WebP
Python 3.12 and FastAPI behind a vanilla TypeScript frontend

chapters.title: Pen, live shapes and Pathfinder on curves
chapters.text: Pen, Curvature and the anchor tools sit beside live shapes with corner widgets, Paintbrush and Blob Brush. All ten Pathfinder operations run through paper.js, with Shape Crafter and Fill Regions.

chapters.title: Multiple fills, live effects and 3D
chapters.text: Objects take multiple fills and strokes, Graphic Styles and live effects, including fifteen warps and the Effect Gallery's 56 effects. 3D Extrude & Bevel, Revolve, Inflate and Plane work on shapes, type and groups.

chapters.title: 93 MCP tools and a terminal inside the window
chapters.text: ./formpath mcp gives Claude Code, Codex and Cursor 93 tools over the whole command catalogue. Window > Terminal opens real shells with a Claude Code button already connected to FormPath's tools.

features.title: Artboards and layers
features.text: Any number of artboards with the Artboard tool and panel.
bullets: Layers and sublayers with colours, lock, template, print and dim
Groups with isolation mode
Clipping masks
16 blend modes and opacity masks

features.title: Drawing
features.text: Pen, Curvature and anchor tools with live shapes editable after drawing.
bullets: Pencil, Smooth, Path Eraser and Join
Rectangle, Rounded Rectangle, Ellipse, Polygon, Star and Flare as live shapes
Paintbrush, Blob Brush, Eraser, Scissors and Knife
Smart guides with equal spacing, snap to pixel, rulers and grids

features.title: Pathfinder on curves
features.text: All ten Pathfinder operations through paper.js.
bullets: Shape Crafter
Fill Regions groups with gap detection
Compound paths, Offset Path and Outline Stroke
Simplify, Average, Divide Objects Below and Split into Grid

features.title: Paint
features.text: Colour in Grayscale, RGB, HSB, CMYK and Web.
bullets: Swatches with global and spot colours
Linear, radial and freeform gradients, and gradient mesh
Patterns with pattern editing mode
Recolor Art and the Color Guide's harmony rules
Stroke panel with dashes, arrowheads and width profiles

features.title: Appearance and effects
features.text: Multiple fills and strokes per object, Graphic Styles and live effects.
bullets: Fifteen warps, Distort and Transform, Drop Shadow, glows and Feather
The Effect Gallery's 56 effects, all live
3D Extrude & Bevel, Revolve, Inflate and Plane
Envelopes, blends, repeats and symbols with seven symbolism tools
Trace Image as a live object with five views

features.title: Type
features.text: Point, area, vertical and on-path type typed on the canvas.
bullets: Area type inside any shape, threaded frames and text wrap
Character and Paragraph panels with OpenType features
Character and Paragraph Styles
Glyphs, Change Case, Find and Replace, Find Font
Create Outlines through real glyph outlines

features.title: Files
features.text: .fpth projects with a library, conflict copies and crash recovery.
bullets: SVG in and out with exact round trips
PDF out with real vectors, shadings, transparency and CMYK
PDF and PDF-compatible .ai in, one artboard per page
PNG, JPEG and WebP, Export for Screens and the Asset Export panel
Placed and linked images

features.title: Live Corners
features.text: Direct Selection shows a corner widget at every corner point of any path.
bullets: Drag to round
Alt-click for inverted or chamfer
Double-click for the Corners dialog

features.title: 26 languages
features.text: English by default, set in Preferences > Interface.
bullets: Spanish (Spain and Mexico), Portuguese (Brazil), French (France and Canada)
Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Japanese and Korean
Translated from FormPath's own English in each

features.title: Agents
features.text: ./formpath mcp gives Claude Code, Codex and Cursor 93 tools.
bullets: From get_image to pathfinder to run_command and run_commands
The window asks the person once
The formpath-harness skill pack teaches agents to look, plan, build, check and deliver

features.title: Terminal and Claude Code inside the window
features.text: Window > Terminal opens a dock of real shells.
bullets: Claude Code button starts your own claude connected to FormPath's tools
The Chat tab answers in plain words while it draws
./formpath cli lists, describes and runs any of the 649 catalogue commands

features.title: Assistant and plugins
features.text: Window > Assistant edits through the same tools on the language model you choose.
bullets: Sandboxed JavaScript plugins add commands

features.title: Zero-flash UI
features.text: Keyed DOM patching, guarded writes, a pre-paint theme boot and reveal after fonts.
bullets: Every interface change is checked in a throttled browser

parity.summary: Re-traced in code at 0.52.0 against 76 Illustrator capability rows, FormPath is graded 75 full, 1 partial and none missing, 75.5 of 76. Only 3D stays partial, for no 3D export, twist or taper. FormPath's own docs/PARITY.md reports 65.5 of 76 from a driven audit at v0.44.0, whose defects were fixed afterwards and not yet re-driven.

requirements: Rust stable and the Tauri 2 system packages for the desktop build
docs.install:
git clone git@github.com:nodemode-dev/formpath.git
cd formpath
./formpath install
docs.agents: ./formpath agents install registers FormPath's MCP server with Claude Code, Codex and Cursor for your user account; ./formpath claude starts Claude Code with its tools attached.

topics.title: Quick Start
topics.text: The README gives install and boot commands for macOS, Linux and Windows (formpath.bat), with a table of the frontend, engine and preview URLs.

topics.title: Manual
topics.text: docs/MANUAL.md is the manual and also the in-app Help.

topics.title: Configuration
topics.text: The engine reads backend/.env; FORMPATH_HOST, FORMPATH_PORT, FORMPATH_DATA_DIR and others are listed in the README.

topics.title: Parity
topics.text: docs/PARITY.md lists what the app covers and what is still partial, row by row.

topics.title: Status
topics.text: The README lists what is not verified yet, including desktop bundles and the limits of PDF import.

items: The Windows desktop app no longer opens to a blank window when the .js file type is set to text/plain in the registry
The engine now serves scripts and stylesheets with their real types
The engine installs on Windows, where Python is named python
The Windows desktop build packs the frontend into the engine with Windows paths
Scripts keep LF line endings on every checkout, and the .bat files keep CRLF
The home screen no longer jumps down when the empty Recent line appears
The desktop splash holds its logo, line and bar in a fixed box
A window smoke test runs in CI on every push
